title: Classes suspended in Surigao Sur town after magnitude 5.9 earthquake

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Classes at all levels in public and private schools in Lingig, Surigao del Sur were suspended Thursday at noon after a series of earthquakes, including a magnitude 5.9 tremor, jolted off its coast. Lingig Mayor Elmer Evangelio issued Memorandum No. 15 halting classes until further notice as a precautionary measure against potential building damage and ongoing aftershocks. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) recorded the magnitude 5.9 tectonic earthquake at 11:19 a.m. off Lingig’s coast. The quake was followed by several aftershocks throughout the day, with magnitudes ranging from 1.7 to 4.3. READ: […]...
